found.quote: PGR students considering the use of Generative AI should discuss and agree appropriate scope, boundaries, and applications with their supervisor at the start of the project or before commencing usage.
found.anchor: 15. What should PGR students consider before using AI?

unsure.quote: Using AI is considered academic misconduct when a student presents the output of an AI technology, such as a large language model (LLM) or paraphrasing application, as their own work without acknowledgment in all situations.
unsure.why: Reads as labelling misconduct rather than defining a term

unsure.quote: Skills in selectively utilising Generative AI as a resource will be required by our graduates.
unsure.why: Graduate requirement, not stated as taught in programmes
